content: Zustand filter state with multi-select arrays: define FilterState interface with selectedCategories: string[], selectedLocations: string[], selectedStatuses: MedicineStatus[], sortField: 'name'|'expiryDate'|'category', sortDirection: 'asc'|'desc'. Actions: addFilter(dimension, value), removeFilter(dimension, value), clearAllFilters(), setSort(field, direction). Extend uiStore.ts by widening the create<UIState & FilterState>()() type union. Use shallow() comparator when selecting multi-select arrays: const selectedCategories = useUIStore(s => s.selectedCategories, shallow) to prevent spurious re-renders from new array references.
